text_block_list.text:
I need to get Эйр Грув back on her
feet. In
order to do that, I first need to
find a chance to
talk to her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I still have no idea what I should say to
her, but
for the time being, I tell her I
simply want to talk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's the big idea? Why did you call
me here?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: I need you to wake up.

text_block_list.text: And what is that supposed to mean?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: I thought we were going to surpass Suzuka.

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I need to overtake her. So
why am I
like this?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I think... for the first time in my life, I'm
scared.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
When I witness her running... I can't even
picture
myself surpassing it, and that
terrifies me!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The way she runs is like nothing I've ever
seen.
Free as a bird, with peerless speed
that touches
the hearts of all watching.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
After experiencing it for myself on the
track, I can
understand all too well.
Those who see that pure
and unfettered
running...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...can't help but feel inspired.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: On the other hand, there's me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
All this time, I have raced as the Empress
in order
to be an ideal for all
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But with the way things are now... I
wonder if
there's any meaning to my
efforts.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: They already have Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The ideal I strove to embody—the
Umamusume
who inspires others to
dream—is already standing
right before
me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
In the face of that... what is there left for
me to
do?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: You and Suzuka aren't the same.

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list:
You have something that only you can show
everyone.

text_block_list.text: Something... only I can...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I've journeyed so far with Эйр Грув,
watching
her closely from her side.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've been the closest one to her and the
one most
enraptured by her running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's why I feel certain that this is
something
only I can tell her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That's right. Эйр Грув is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A... challenger, you say?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I tell Эйр Грув exactly how she's
appeared to
me up until now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"To become the ideal for all
Umamusume."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
From the very beginning, Эйр Грув has
been
constantly challenging herself to
achieve this
incredibly grand ambition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has always remained disciplined,
always
looking forward, in order to live
up to this ideal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She guides the academy as student
council vice
president. She guides the
younger students as
their senior. And all
the while, she's continued to
run in the
Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've watched her every step of the way.
And it's
not just me—all the Umamusume
at the academy
can testify to her efforts
too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies and the
Triple Tiara
series, she refused to falter,
give up, or look
back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's always been the proud Empress,
constantly
challenging herself with her
eyes fixed on her
dreams.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Don't rest on your laurels." "I need to
aim for
ever greater heights."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: "That's why you need to stick with me."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
These are a handful of the things Air
Groove has
said as she continues to
move forward and
challenge herself.
That's why she's the Empress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has always been the undaunted
challenger,
striving tirelessly to be every
Umamusume's ideal!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize that was how you saw
me...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: He isn't the only one, Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: She isn't the only one, Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have also been watching you, and I feel
exactly
the same way.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: President...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I came here because I have something I
want to
show you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Come.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф leads us to the area of
the beach
where students train during
summer camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Take a look, Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: I can still... keep going!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: I'm sooo tired!
text_block_list.name: Summer Camp Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe Эйр Грув did this
regimen last
year... She's tough as nails!
text_block_list.name: Summer Camp Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
That's why we need to keep going! We
need to
work even harder if we're ever
going to surpass
her!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: You said it!
text_block_list.name: Summer Camp Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Heeey, Dober! You still at it?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ryan...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
You're really hittin' it recently. I hope
you're not
overdoing it. How you
feeling?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for looking out for me, but I'm
okay. I'm
not overdoing it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: I'm challenging myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: I'm challenging my own limits.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Dober...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I'll be back soon. See you back there.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Come on, everyone! We can keep going!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: YEAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Summer Camp Students

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Your energy is infectious, Dober.
You've
hooked me as well.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That's it! I'm joining you guys! Let's
pump our
muscles to the max!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Dober...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Do you understand now?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
They're all chasing after the Empress.
You, Air
Groove.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
They've seen you take on challenge
after
challenge and have been inspired
by you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
When they struggle and fall down, it is
you, as
their ideal, that pushes them to
stand up once
more.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
They stand back up and challenge
themselves to
achieve glory on their own
two feet.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As president of Академия Тайсен's
student
council, I owe you my thanks.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for guiding our
younger
students.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I must be going now. I'll leave you two
alone.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф walks away, leaving us in
silence.
But I know exactly what to say
to Эйр Грув now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
No matter how high the wall that blocks
my way, I
need only keep challenging
myself without fear or
hesitation.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: That is how I can demonstrate...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...No, that is how I have always demonstrated my ideal to the world!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge Suzuka once more.
So that I
can remain the ideal everyone
strives toward.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Will you stick with me?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: That's why you're my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Preparations for our rematch against
Silence
Suzuka begin now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
First, we need to get back in the game
at the
Sapporo Kinen and show everyone
that the
Empress is as strong as ever!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
